bias_targets.methodology: Measuring true positive rate gaps (GAP) across author ethnicities (African American English vs. Standard American English) in a binary sentiment classification task using Twitter data under varying degrees of dataset stereotyping and class imbalance.

Measuring true positive rate gaps (GAP) in multi-class profession prediction from online biographies, and evaluating Pearson correlation disparities in text regression for valence and arousal prediction of Facebook posts across male and female authors.
